proposed_learning_target: complete-workflow RTT change from flipping one operation to its other eligible host in the current schedule
environment: unchanged 8 jobs x 10 operations x 4 machines; 2 eligible hosts each
native_control: compiled exact FIFO replay of all 80 single-flip neighbors; best-improvement descent up to 64 rounds
training_stop: if p95 validation time including constructing the starting schedule and exactly scoring all 80 single-flip moves is <=2ms, stop move-value training: the exact same target and best move are already available within budget
otherwise: require >=5pct validation full-plan gain opportunity over matched hand search before training GNN/MPoff/hand move-value scorers
live_gate: always run 32 fresh cases with ECT, exact best single move, exact descent, three frozen parent GNNs with ECT guarding and actual Knative; complete task-record and scalar/native parity audits
scope: single-flip ranking in this workflow family, not multi-move lookahead or larger workflows
fairness: one CPU thread, shared objective and information; native compilation and model loading excluded from both steady-state timings; no fast-math; include wrapper, validation and data conversion overhead
